question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. **"Ocassion".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ocassion **is Incorrect. The Correct spelling is **Occasion **(अवसर) - A special or particular event, time, or happening.

 
 
• **Example**: We held a party for no particular occasion, just to have fun.
 
 
 
• The other spellings are correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is "Ocassion". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agreeable** (सुखद) - Pleasant or to one's liking; willing to agree to something.

 
 
• **Example**: The weather was agreeable, making our picnic even more enjoyable. 
 
 
 
• **Formulae **(सूत्र) - Plural of formula, used to describe a list of ingredients or a set of rules to follow.
 
 
• **Example**: The scientist carefully wrote down the formulae for his experiments.
 
 
 
• **Waitress **(वेट्रेस) - A female server who takes orders and serves food in a restaurant.
 
 
• **Example**: The waitress was very friendly and made excellent recommendations.
